text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan-Libyan commission aims at giving new breath to Arab Maghreb Union.
- Government and General Confederation of Moroccan businesses hold meeting to assess measures taken to speed firms upgrading ahead of international competition.

- Housing ministry considers creating a national housing fund to finance social units and extending mortgage bank Credit Hotelier et Immobilier (CIH) privileges to all banks. Such measures would facilitate access to loans.
- Libya and Morocco to reinforce political dialogue.
- Weather forecasts expect rain in main farming regions in coming days.
- State-owned electricity utility Office National de l'Electricite says ready to cut bills of industrial firms if state alleviates taxation on production factors.
